nodes.label: TAPAIKO WARD (Nepal ward-finder Android app)
nodes.rationale: Flutter + flutter_map Android app that reuses the maps-clone deployment's live data URL and file layout so it needs no backend and no local serving (Python not required); the site must stay reachable for uncached data.

nodes.label: Nepal admin hierarchy data model (province → district → locallevel → ward)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the maps-clone web app's path-driven layout (province.json → districts/{province}.json → locallevels/{district}.json → wards/{district}_{locallevel}.json) so the same GeoJSON files can be fetched from the live site without a dedicated backend.
nodes.norm_label: nepal admin hierarchy data model (province → district → locallevel → ward)

nodes.label: WARD_DISTRICT_ALIASES (Rukum East/West → Rukum quirk)
nodes.rationale: Ward files are stored under the legacy district name Rukum for Rukum East/Rukum West, so lookups must resolve the alias before opening the wards file.

nodes.label: On-device GeoJSON cache
nodes.rationale: Every fetched GeoJSON file is cached under the app's documents dir so repeat lookups work offline and the ~6 MB province file is only re-read from disk after the first identification.

nodes.label: Point-in-polygon ward identification
nodes.rationale: GPS location / tap resolves to a ward by walking a point-in-polygon test down the province → district → local level → ward hierarchy; first identification loads the 6 MB province file, subsequent lookups hit the disk cache.

nodes.label: TAPAIKO WARD Flutter web bootstrap page
nodes.rationale: base href is a build-time placeholder replaced by the --base-href argument so the Flutter web build can be served from non-root paths.
nodes.norm_label: tapaiko ward flutter web bootstrap page

nodes.label: App Icon (hdpi)
nodes.rationale: These 10 PNGs are all density/size variants of the SAME app icon: Android mipmap launcher icons at hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi (E:\projects\maps\maps-apk\android\app\src\main\res\mipmap-{density}\ic_launcher.png) plus web/PWA variants (E:\projects\maps\maps-apk\web\favicon.png, E:\projects\maps\maps-apk\web\icons\Icon-192.png, Icon-512.png, Icon-maskable-192.png, Icon-maskable-512.png). File sizes scale monotonically with resolution, consistent with resized copies of one source art. One shared node is created per instructions, with source_file pointing at the hdpi launcher file. AMBIGUOUS: icon pixel content could not be visually inspected by this model (no image input support), so the visual design (subject, colors, text) is unverified and should be reviewed by a vision-capable pass.
